basic_info.description: Charming two-story home in San Francisco's vibrant Parkside neighborhood. The main floor offers living room with fireplace, dining area, eat-in kitchen, a full bathroom featuring both tub and stall shower and two spacious bedrooms. Downstairs expands your options with a versatile family room, kitchenette, and full bathroom.  Use the sliding glass door to access the deck and large yard ideal for outdoor gatherings. Fresh interior paint and new roof. The 1-car garage provides convenient laundry hookups. Prime location blocks from Great Highway, Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, restaurants, cafes, and schools. This well-maintained property presents an opportunity to create your ideal home while enjoying all the Sunset District has to offer.
